services.desc: Details Join us every single Friday this summer from 5:30-10:30pm for the most epic bar crawl on Lake Travis. You will travel to Shack 512 and Beachside Billy's in a spacious captained pontoon boat and enjoy stunning views of the lake, delicious food, drink specials, live music, and more! quotes.author: Christina M.
quotes.text: We came to Austin on a Bachelorette trip and this was the highlight of our trip! John was a fantastic photographer, bartender, and DJ in addition to being a wonderful captain! Tide up was fun, affordable, and accommodating. I would recommend for any occasion!

quotes.author: Riki R.
quotes.text: Rented for birthday, we all had such a good time! Perfect birthday celebration. The captain was awesome, he took great care of us. Great staff, very accommodating. Boat was nice, played music, had a lily pad, everything we wanted! Definitely recommend!

quotes.author: Kristen C.
quotes.text: Wes was absolutely amazing! He made sure we were all safe and comfortable throughout our entire boat tour. We were so lucky to have him as our captain! Definitely recommend this company for anyone looking for a good time in Austin!! :)

quotes.author: Cassey R.
quotes.text: We rented a boat through Tide Up for a friend’s birthday and everything was amazing! Management was very helpful and quick to respond to any questions or concerns we had. Will definitely book again in the future!

quotes.author: Caroline M.
quotes.text: WES WAS THE BEST! Picked up the slack when our original driver cancelled. Couldn't be more considerate to make sure we have a good time, and also stayed safe. He saved the day and we were so thankful!
